# Draft:Detor: The Rise of a Warrior Hunter

Detor: The Rise of a Warrior Hunter is a Ghanian film starring Ekufa Adjeani Asiedu, Solomon Fixon-Owoo Jr., and Kofi Boakye. Written and directed by Mark Cofie, the story follows Detor, inspired by his father's mystical tales, as he embarks on a journey to become a warrior hunter and fulfill the prophecy of Ngotsie. The film was released on 21 March 2024.
